# Aleksandr Ivannikov — ivannikov.pro

> Premium engineering studio. AI under the hood. 13 years of shipping production systems for SaaS, fintech, and web3 teams. Founder: Aleksandr Ivannikov.

Independent engineering studio led by Aleksandr Ivannikov — full-stack engineer with 13 years of experience, 50+ projects shipped. Specialises in AI-era product engineering: building AI-native features (agents, RAG, tooling), AI-optimisation of existing products (docs, API, content for LLM consumption), and complex full-stack delivery for B2B SaaS. Long-standing web3 / blockchain expertise as adjacent capability.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://ivannikov.pro/en/services): full list of engagements offered.
- [AI Development: Agents & RAG](https://ivannikov.pro/en/services/ai-development): autonomous agent systems, retrieval-augmented generation, LLM-integrated product features.
- [AI Optimisation for product teams](https://ivannikov.pro/en/services/ai-optimisation): docs/API/content audit and improvement for LLM agent visibility (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overview).
- [Smart contract development](https://ivannikov.pro/en/services/smart-contracts): Solidity, EVM, DeFi, NFT — adjacent expertise.
- [Telegram bots & Mini Apps](https://ivannikov.pro/en/services/telegram-bots): Telegraf bots, native Telegram Mini Apps.
- [Technical consulting](https://ivannikov.pro/en/services/consulting): architecture review, technical co-founder engagements.
